# awesome-private-ai

> A curated list of AI tools that protect data sovereignty through architecture, ranging from on-device processing to self-hosted servers and cryptographically isolated services.

The project is a documentation list maintained by Brethof AI, categorized into four privacy levels from on-device to no-retention cloud services. It includes entries for open-weights models and privacy auditing tools, with specific notes on telemetry defaults and how to disable them.

## Docs

- [awesome-private-ai](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/main/README.md): A curated list of AI tools prioritizing data sovereignty through architectural privacy, organized by a four-level security ladder.
- [Why this list exists — and how it differs from awesome-local-ai](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists--and-how-it-differs-from-awesome-local-ai): Distinction between local and private tools, plus the four-tier privacy ladder used to categorize entries.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#legend): Symbol key explaining icons for hosting type, source availability, audit status, pricing, and region.
- [Level 1 — On Your Device](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-1--on-your-device): Local AI tools where data never leaves the machine, including voice transcription, knowledge stores, and offline chat applications.
- [Level 2 — On Your Server](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-2--on-your-server): Self-hosted AI servers and workspaces you control, with notes on default telemetry settings and how to disable them.
- [Level 3 — Can't See, Provably](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-3--cant-see-provably): Hosted AI services using cryptography, such as enclaves and end-to-end encryption, to provably prevent operator data access.
- [Level 4 — Processes, Never Stores](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-4--processes-never-stores): Services with no-retention commitments, local or user-keyed storage, and verifiable data flows.
- [Open-Weights Models You Can Audit](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#open-weights-models-you-can-audit): Open-weights AI models with public licenses, allowing local execution and verification of inference paths for privacy assurance.
- [Privacy Auditing Tools](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#privacy-auditing-tools): Network monitoring and firewall tools for verifying vendor privacy claims by inspecting actual traffic and outbound connections.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Links to related lists covering local AI, license analysis, Linux distros, and MCP servers.
